lines: She says not to come in yet.
She's looking for the good cups.

missing_model.fiction: The porch light is on, but nobody is home.

wrong_hash.fiction: She answers the door. It isn't quite her.

no_extension.fiction: The house is there. The door isn't.
no_extension.fix: A game library is missing or could not start. Verify the game files in Steam, or reinstall the game.

load_failed.fix:
The model could not load, usually because there isn't enough memory. It needs about 4 GB of graphics memory or 8 GB of system memory. Close other programs and try again.
Details: {detail}

no_gpu.fiction: She's moving slowly today. She asks you to be patient with her.
no_gpu.fix: No supported graphics card was found, so the game is running on your processor. Replies will be slower. Updating your graphics driver may help.

gpu_oom.fiction: She's so tired tonight. She asks you to be patient with her.
gpu_oom.fix: Your graphics card doesn't have enough free memory for the model, so the game is running {where}. Replies will be slower. Closing other programs may help.
